latest_release.body:
Enhancements:

  * bwrap now accepts multiple --sync-fd arguments and will handle
    all of the fds.

Bug fixes:

  * O_PATH is used when opening parent directories in the new root,
    fixing an error when read permission is missing. (#806, ValveSoftware/steam-runtime#855).

Thanks: smcv, swick
